PLAN THE WORK

The right next step for your boiler.

A new boiler should suit the home, the heating system and the hot water you use. If an existing boiler has a problem, describing its symptoms helps distinguish a repair enquiry from routine servicing.

For any gas work, check the engineer’s current Gas Safe ID and the categories they are qualified to work on before work starts. Confirm service availability when booking.

Is a service the same as a repair?

No. A service is planned maintenance. A repair addresses a fault. Tell Connor if the boiler is not working when you enquire.
